newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-NOTTS NEW SIGNING ZAHID MAY RETURN HOME.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NOTTS NEW SIGNING ZAHID MAY RETURN HOME.

text.p: Nottinghamshire's recent overseas signing, Pakistan pace bowler Mohammad Zahid, is on the verge of being sent home without bowling a ball in anger in county cricket.
If the result of a final scan on Thursday on the test player's persistent back injury confirms Notts cricket manager Alan Ormrod's worst fears, the county may have to cut their losses.

Zahid has already undergone three scans to try to pinpoint the extent of his problem since his arrival at the start of the month. He also received a course of injections when soft tissue damage was discovered two weeks ago.
However, the injury has refused to clear up and the club have to decide whether to persevere with Zahid, 20, or attempt to sign a replacement after considering medical advice.
Ormrod said: "I've tried to keep him positive during these frustrating weeks but we need to sort things out sooner rather than later."
